mapper.sql: id, session_id, session_key_digest, creator_client_id, creator_display_name, participant_client_id, participant_display_name, status, created_at, join_deadline_at, creator_connected_at, participant_connected_at, connected_at, creator_last_message_at, participant_last_message_at, closed_at, close_reason, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM temporary_chat_session WHERE session_key_digest = #{sessionKeyDigest} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE temporary_chat_session SET participant_client_id = #{participantClientId}, participant_display_name = #{participantDisplayName}, version = version + 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'WAITING' AND participant_client_id IS NULL AND join_deadline_at > #{now}

UPDATE temporary_chat_session SET status = 'ACTIVE', creator_connected_at = COALESCE(creator_connected_at, #{creatorConnectedAt}), participant_connected_at = COALESCE(participant_connected_at, #{participantConnectedAt}), connected_at = COALESCE(connected_at, #{connectedAt}), creator_last_message_at = COALESCE(creator_last_message_at, #{connectedAt}), participant_last_message_at = COALESCE(participant_last_message_at, #{connectedAt}), version = version + 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'WAITING' AND participant_client_id IS NOT NULL

UPDATE temporary_chat_session SET creator_last_message_at = CASE WHEN #{role} = 'CREATOR' THEN #{messageAt} ELSE creator_last_message_at END, participant_last_message_at = CASE WHEN #{role} = 'PARTICIPANT' THEN #{messageAt} ELSE participant_last_message_at END, version = version + 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE temporary_chat_session SET status = #{status}, closed_at = #{closedAt}, close_reason = #{closeReason}, version = version + 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'ACTIVE')
UPDATE temporary_chat_session SET status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = #{closedAt}, close_reason = #{closeReason}, version = version + 1 WHERE status IN ('WAITING', 'ACTIVE')
